name: qurandeen
description: Plateforme open-source d'etude et de decouverte de l'Islam (Coran, hadith, tafsir, fiqh, histoire, savants, concepts) - sans IA, sources verifiables.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api --if-present && npm run test -w apps/web --if-present
